# Masterpiece Typing & Travels LLC

Masterpiece is a premier typing, document clearing, travels, and business services provider operating in Al Ain and Dubai, UAE. We specialize in legal translation, certificate attestation, business setup, visa services, and notarization.

## Contact Information
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +971 58 995 8440
- **Email:** gcc.masterpiece@gmail.com
- **Locations:** Al Ain (Abu Dhabi) & Al Twar 4 (Dubai), United Arab Emirates

---

## Core Services & Pages

### 1. [Translation Services](https://masterpiecegcc.com/translation.html)
Comprehensive translation in over 150 languages.
- **Legal Translation:** Certified contracts, court documents, and legal agreements.
- **Interpretation:** Event, conference, and business meeting interpretation.
- **Technical & Scientific:** Software localization, medical translation, patents, engineering, and financial reports.
- **Official Translations:** Sworn, certified, and Power of Attorney (POA) translation.

### 2. [Attestation Services](https://masterpiecegcc.com/attestation.html)
Document attestation and legalization for UAE and global use.
- **Educational Certificates:** Degree, diploma, and transcript attestation.
- **Personal Certificates:** Marriage, birth, medical, and death certificates.
- **Country-Specific:** UK, USA, Indian, Pakistani, and Philippine certificate attestation.
- **Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA):** Final UAE MOFA attestation.

### 3. [Business Setup Services](https://masterpiecegcc.com/business.html)
End-to-end support for business incorporation in the UAE.
- **Free Zone Setup:** DMCC, JAFZA, DAFZA, RAK ICC, and Sharjah Free Zones with 100% ownership.
- **Mainland Setup:** Operating with local sponsors or 100% ownership anywhere in the UAE.
- **Offshore Setup:** Wealth management and asset protection company formation.
- **Corporate Services:** Trademark registration and corporate bank account opening assistance.

### 4. [Visa Services](https://masterpiecegcc.com/visa.html)
Entry permit and residency processing in the UAE.
- **Residency Visas:** Investor, Employment, Family, Freelance, and Maid visas.
- **Entry Permits:** Business and Tourist visas (30, 60, or 90 days).

### 5. [Notarization Services](https://masterpiecegcc.com/notarization.html)
Official notarization of legal documents.
- **Agreements:** Power of Attorney (POA), Memorandum of Association (MOA), Memorandums of Understanding (MOU), and Wills.
- **Notices & Letters:** No Objection Certificates (NOC), Legal Notices, Undertakings, and Sworn Affidavits.
